acceptanceCriteria: The prose states the current `corvint frontier` status, the two bare-basename citations carry line ranges or are explicitly exempt, and the check reports skipped citations.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the fresh-agent leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, BASE d18db3d). Found while fixing V1-0148: the file still says frontier is unimplemented although `corvint frontier` ran in step 8, and two file-only citations are not scanned. The reviewer leg added: line 74 cites only the ID regex at internal/lrfrepo/ocm.go:37 for the full requirement-line grammar (prefix check at ocm.go:581), and the bare-basename citation change-frontier-v0.md:217 at line 121 is stale.
title: SPEC-TOOLCHAIN-INTEGRATION.md: stale `frontier unimplemented` prose and two bare-basename citations the line-citation check skips
